{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the trial data
data = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/trial.csv')

# Replace sentinel value -999.0 with NaN in biomarker_baseline
data['biomarker_baseline'] = data['biomarker_baseline'].replace(-999.0, pd.NA)

# Compute response rate for treatment group
response_rate_treatment = data[data['arm'] == 'treatment']['responded'].mean()

# Compute response rate for control group
response_rate_control = data[data['arm'] == 'control']['responded'].mean()

# Compute difference in proportions (treatment - control)
treatment_effect = response_rate_treatment - response_rate_control

# Print results
print(f"Response rate (treatment): {response_rate_treatment:.4f}")
print(f"Response rate (control): {response_rate_control:.4f}")
print(f"Treatment effect (diff in proportions): {treatment_effect:.4f}")"}
